resources.string:
Smooth Average (Motion Blur & Silk)
Averages pixels across frames. Ideal for silky waterfalls, smooth ocean waves, moving clouds, and erasing moving people from daytime scenes.

Light Trails (Star Trails & Fireworks)
Retains maximum brightness per pixel. Ideal for night traffic light painting, star trails across the night sky, and fireworks.

Night Noise Reduction
Multi-frame temporal variance filtering eliminates sensor grain in low light without blurring fine details. Ideal for handheld or tripod dark landscapes.

HDR Fusion
Combines highlight and shadow detail across multi-exposure frames. Ideal for sunsets and high-contrast landscapes.

Motion Deghosting
Isolates static background from moving subjects to eliminate ghosting artifacts during multi-frame stacking.
